name: eFootball Mobile
payout_notice: The organiser pays the confirmed winner NGN 1,000 directly by bank transfer. This prize is not credited again as withdrawable GP. Paystack Transfers are not assumed to be available.
fourth_player: Organiser (account to be identified during setup)
registration: Each player, including the organiser, must join and pay through the normal platform flow. Do not create paid entries or debit accounts from this file.
publication_requirements: Configure the actual event and its 1v1 competition rules before accepting entries.
Publish registration and check-in deadlines, match settings, no-show and replay rules, and cancellation/refund terms.
Complete the launch checklist and disclose the direct bank prize payout.
Keep the organiser out of adjudicating their own match or dispute.
Record a real bank payment reference only after the winner has actually been paid; never fabricate payout proof.
